scenarios.expected: Cancelling a sales order must not leave its SO-scoped draft auto-purchase-request actionable for later submission.

implementation: Current SalesOrderService cancellation cancels the active MRP plan and planned/confirmed/paused work orders, but the current trace did not show cancellation of linked draft auto-purchase-requests.
PurchaseRequestService submission validates sourcing and department but does not revalidate that the originating sales order or MRP plan is still active.
tests: Current sales-order cancellation tests cover active deliveries and stale terminal-state protection, not linked draft auto-purchase-request cleanup.

scenarios.expected: A draft expected GRN belonging to a cancelled purchase order must not be finalized into receiving.

implementation: Purchase-order cancellation allows a draft GRN to remain.
GrnService finalizeDraft checks that the GRN is draft but does not require the purchase order to remain receivable before moving the GRN to pending_qc.
tests: Current tests cover cancellation when only a draft GRN exists, but no test finalizes that draft after cancellation.

scenarios.expected: Attendance, leave, and approved-overtime changes after payroll computation or approval must invalidate or block the payroll result before finalization.

implementation: Attendance mutability is blocked for finalized/disbursed periods, but computed/approved periods remain mutable.
Payroll approval checks computed rows and errors but does not hash or freeze attendance inputs.
tests: Current tests cover computed-period recomputation and ordinary attendance locking, but no post-compute approved-OT or leave mutation invalidation scenario.

scenarios.expected: A standard invoice must require a confirmed delivery and prevent multiple finalized invoices from consuming the same delivery lines.

implementation: Invoice finalization checks confirmed delivery status and exact delivery-line matching.
Invoice draft creation can target a delivery before confirmation, and the schema has no unique delivery/source-line consumption constraint.
tests: Current tests cover finalization delivery gates, but no duplicate direct invoice-draft/finalization consumption test.

scenarios.expected: An ordinary GRN with a fractional received quantity must produce QC evidence for the full decimal quantity without truncation or skipping.

implementation: TriggerIncomingQC converts received quantity through float-to-int truncation and skips values below one.
The single-screen receive path rejects fractional QC quantities, but ordinary GRN creation uses the separate listener path.
tests: Current tests cover fractional single-screen refusal but no ordinary GRN fractional incoming-QC handoff.

scenarios.expected: Each product in a multi-product return request must receive an independent return inspection before disposition.

implementation: Return staging loops by product, but InspectionService non-outgoing idempotency uses stage/entity type/entity id without product id.
The database uniqueness index remains entity-wide for non-incoming/non-outgoing return inspections.
tests: Current return tests use one product or multiple lines for the same product; no genuine multi-product inspection/disposition test.

scenarios.expected: A machine breakdown must pause the active work order, create one corrective maintenance work order, and retain a recoverable downtime link even when automation configuration is missing.

implementation: Current breakdown listener creates an idempotent corrective MWO when a system automation actor is available.
When no actor is available it logs and returns while the listener records a completed breakdown outcome.
tests: Current tests cover WO-associated and idle-machine breakdowns with a seeded automation actor, not the missing-actor failure path.

scenarios.expected: Manual, daily, and automatic MRP runs must not concurrently plan the same stock/Sales Orders without a plant-wide execution fence.

implementation: Automatic queue jobs have a plant overlap middleware.
Manual controller runs and daily command runs invoke the engine without the equivalent plant-wide lock.
tests: Current tests cover sorted automatic-job identity and sequential shared-stock behavior, not manual-versus-automatic or daily-versus-automatic overlap.

scenarios.expected: Landed freight and customs allocations must reconcile exactly and capitalize into inventory weighted-average cost with a balanced GL entry.

implementation: LandedCostService persists allocations but current source has no Inventory WAC or Accounting GL consumer.
Allocation uses float arithmetic and independently rounds components, so residual cents can be lost or overallocated.
tests: Current probe tests explicitly demonstrate no downstream consumer and residual rounding issues.

scenarios.expected: Changing an employee bank account must use the HR plus Finance dual-approval workflow; direct employee updates must not bypass it.

implementation: Profile-update requests now encrypt changes and scope the review list.
UpdateEmployeeRequest and EmployeeService still allow direct bank-account edits under the ordinary employee edit permission.
tests: Current ProfileUpdateSodTest covers the request workflow, but no test compares direct Employee update against the Finance gate.

scenarios.expected: Supplier portal password expiry must force a password-change response before supplier data routes are served.

implementation: Supplier routes use password-change middleware but not CheckPortalPasswordExpiry.
The expiry middleware is customer-only.
tests: Customer timed-expiry tests exist; no equivalent supplier timed-expiry test.

scenarios.expected: Internal password change and password reset must reject the user's current password as the new password.

implementation: Password history checks run against previous password history rows.
The current password hash is inserted into history only after the new password is accepted.
tests: Current password-history tests reuse older passwords, not the current password.

scenarios.expected: Department-scoped approval badges must count only rows visible through the owning module's row scope.

implementation: Approval Board reuses ApprovalSourceScope and module policies.
BadgeService counts leave and purchase-request rows using permissions/roles without applying the owning row scopes.
tests: Current badge tests cover permissions and global counts, not cross-department badge isolation.

scenarios.expected: A delayed outbox event must either hydrate the exact emitted model version or explicitly surface stale-event handling rather than silently using newer state.

implementation: OutboxEventCodec stores a model version from updated_at.
decodeModel loads the current row by id but does not compare or enforce the stored version.
tests: Current outbox tests cover encoding, leasing, retry, and stale claims, not model mutation between encode and decode.

scenarios.expected: Disabling the CRM feature must close the authenticated ERP inquiry inbox routes as well as the CRM UI routes.

implementation: Landing inquiry routes use auth and permissions but omit feature:crm.
Normal CRM routes include feature:crm.
tests: Current inquiry tests cover auth/permission behavior, not feature-disabled behavior.

scenarios.expected: Forecast actual reconciliation must be safely rerunnable after historical source orders change, without permanently freezing an old actual quantity.

implementation: reconcileActuals only processes rows whose actual_quantity is null.
It writes the calculated value permanently from live sales-order data.
tests: Current reconciliation CLI smoke coverage does not assert actual_quantity/variance mutation or rerun behavior.

scenarios.expected: Repeating a partial final-pay computation must not create a second final-pay loan payment for the same clearance.

implementation: FinalPayService records final-pay payments without an idempotency key.
Existing settlement reuse includes prior amounts but does not uniquely identify a partial replay payment.
tests: Current final-pay tests cover full-payoff recomputation, not repeated partial settlement.

scenarios.expected: Depreciation-run API responses must expose journal entry identifiers as HashIDs, never raw integer IDs.

implementation: DepreciationService returns an integer journal_entry_id in its result.
AssetDepreciationController returns that result directly.
tests: Current depreciation endpoint tests check processed periods/rows, not response identifier shape.

scenarios.expected: An internal customer return item must match the source product and be the mapped finished-good inventory item.

implementation: Internal source options return products but allow the SPA to select any inventory item.
ReturnRequestService validates source ownership but not product-to-item identity or finished-good type.
tests: Current scenario fixture pairs an invoice product with a raw-material item and expects creation.
